section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalising proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1-4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: Artifact is a Phase 7 phase output. No structural reference to a Grant Agreement Annex, Model Grant Agreement Annex, or 'AGA' template as a schema source. The only structural references are unit_cost_budget.json (the sanctioned §8.1 derivation) and named CLAUDE.md sections used as governing authority, not annex schemas.
check_notes.13.2: No invented call constraint, scope requirement, expected outcome, or expected impact is asserted. Instrument-regime characterizations (MSCA-PF = unit-cost, mono-beneficiary) are grounded in CLAUDE.md §8.1 (which names MSCA as unit-cost) and the referenced unit_cost_budget.json derivation; no call requirement is fabricated.
check_notes.13.3: Partner identifiers (HOST, DATA_PARTNER, TRANSFER_PARTNER, VALIDATION_PARTNER, FELLOW) and WP identifiers (WP1-WP5) are coverage-check references to upstream consortium/WP phase outputs derived from Tier 3, sourced in each entry's budget_line_reference to unit_cost_budget.json; they are not fabricated new facts. No budget figure, team size, or equipment is invented — the assessment_note explicitly records that NO numeric budget value (euro amounts, rates, coefficient, person-months) was materialised, copied, computed, or quoted. Conservatively applied and documented; no fabrication present.
check_notes.13.4: Applicability trigger not met: artifact schema_id is 'orch.phase7.budget_gate_assessment.v1' (the Phase 7 gate itself), not an 'orch.tier5.' or 'orch.phase8.' artifact. No Phase 8 content and no budget-dependent proposal claims are present. Gate PASS for a unit-cost instrument on a complete deterministic derivation is exactly what §8.4/amendment C1 sanctions.
